title: Replace throwsA(anything) with a typed matcher in 20 validateIntegrity insert tests
why: throwsA(anything) is satisfied by any thrown object — a NoSuchMethodError from an unrelated null-dereference, a StateError from wrong DB state, or the intended Drift required-field validation all pass identically. These 20 tests (17 in user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart, 3 in user_database_companion_coverage_test.dart) assert only that insert() didn't silently succeed, not that Drift's required-field validation is what actually fired; a regression that made that validation silently no-op while something else in the same call happened to throw would still report green.
recommendation: Replace `throwsA(anything)` with `throwsA(isA<InvalidDataException>())` (or whatever concrete type Drift's generated validateIntegrity throws) at all 20 sites.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn 'throwsA(anything)' learning_tracker/test/core/database/` returns zero matches in these two files.
Each replaced matcher is exercised by a corresponding red-first run (assert it still fails if the required-field check is removed from the source table).
